entities.name: Sigrid, God-Favored
entities.description: Human warrior of Kaldheim and spiritual leader of the Beskir blessed by Alrund.

entities.name: Hurrik
entities.description: Sigrid's ancestor who saved Alrund's life.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God who gifted Feltmark to Hurrik's descendants.

entities.name: Feltmark
entities.description: Land gifted by Alrund to Hurrik and his descendants.

entities.name: Cosmos Bear
entities.description: Bear that approached young Sigrid and pressed its snout against her forehead.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm whose armies were led by the human clan leaders.

entities.name: King Harald
entities.description: King with whom the clan leaders agreed elves and humans must live in peace.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: Elven realm to which elves would return.

events.summary: A Cosmos Bear approaches the young Sigrid without attacking, seen as a renewal of Alrund's pledge.
events.quote: It instead pressed its snout against her forehead, then returned to the forest from which it came.

events.summary: Sigrid and the other clan leaders lead the Bretagard armies against the invading army during Tibalt's Doomskar.
events.quote: lead the Bretagard armies against the invading army that swept open Omenpaths

events.summary: Sigrid and the clan leaders agree with King Harald that elves and humans must live in peace.
events.quote: elves and humans must live in peace until the elves would manage to return to Skemfar

relations.note: She is the spiritual leader of the Beskir.
relations.quote: Sigrid is the spiritual leader of the Beskir.
Sigrid's ancestor Hurrik saved the god Alrund 's life
